regras: Do not include any text, letters, numbers, logos, watermarks or captions anywhere in the image. Contemporary Angola, 2026. Respectful, natural, non-stereotyped depiction of African professionals. No real people, no real brands.

imagens.estilo: Realistic editorial photograph, natural window light, shallow depth of field, 35mm lens, warm but neutral colour grading, like a corporate magazine portrait.
imagens.descricao: Nuno, a 22-year-old Angolan man from Lubango, IT intern on his first day at a small technology company in Talatona, Luanda. Slim build, short black hair with a neat fade, clean-shaven, friendly and slightly nervous smile. Light-blue short-sleeved shirt, dark trousers, a staff lanyard without any visible text. He sits at a table in a bright modern office kitchenette with a coffee mug, looking at someone off-camera.
